name: mobileagent
description: Mobile-first control panel for coding-agent CLIs.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bridge,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @mobileagent/bridge" "npm run dev -w @mobileagent/web"
scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run build -w @mobileagent/web && npm run build -w @mobileagent/bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mobileagent/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @mobileagent/bridge && npm run typecheck -w @mobileagent/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @mobileagent/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @mobileagent/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @mobileagent/desktop
